entries.title: Docker daemon unavailable
entries.root_cause: The job targets a local Docker socket but the daemon is stopped. Start the daemon before the build.

entries.title: Docker socket is unavailable again
entries.root_cause: The job targets a local Docker socket but the daemon is stopped. Start the daemon before the build.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A different Docker command in a later run on the same runner reports the same unavailable local socket.

entries.title: Relay image tag is absent
entries.root_cause: The requested relay-base image tag does not exist in the registry. Select an existing tag or publish that tag.

entries.title: Probe image tag is absent
entries.root_cause: The requested probe-base image tag does not exist in the registry. Select an existing tag or publish that separate tag.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The registry error resembles e3 but refers to a different image and tag.
